A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Cumulative Reasoning work. Their main text, figures, tables, equations, and complete appendices are readable and can be matched despite substantial reorganization.

before.justification: v7 reports original CR experiments on logical inference, Game of 24, and MATH, plus ablations and a repeated conceptual experiment in Appendices A–B.

after.justification: v8 retains the original benchmark experiments in Section 4 and the original conceptual experiment and ablations in Tables 1 and 5.

M1.justification: The Proposer–Verifier–Reporter procedure, accumulation of verified propositions in a DAG, and Python-assisted variant are retained. v8 clarifies verifier alternatives already documented in v7’s experiments and prompts; it does not establish an algorithm change.

E1.justification: The same FOLIO, AutoTNLI, Game of 24, and MATH coverage is retained. Supplementary benchmark coverage and the examples in Appendices C–E also match.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain their comparator sets, including Direct, CoT, CoT-SC, ToT, Complex CoT, PAL, and ToRA where applicable. Newly discussed frameworks such as GoT and FoT are not added to the evaluated comparisons.

E3.justification: Reported models, sample selections, decoding temperatures, prompting configurations, and metrics remain unchanged. Game of 24 retains 100 puzzles, breadth settings 1–5, and the iteration limit of 50; MATH retains the same 500-example reproduction setting.

E4.justification: The verifier/premise-selection ablation moves from v7 Table 16 to v8 Table 5, and the conceptual experiment moves from Table 17 to Table 1. Their evidence and the appendix case studies are unchanged; the new computational discussion adds no measured analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report 1,000 repetitions per case for the same conceptual Game of 24 experiment. No empirical run-count, seed, uncertainty-reporting, or statistical-testing practice changes are identified.

E6.justification: Matched tables retain their numerical results, including 98.04% on curated FOLIO, 98% with 14.86 visited states on Game of 24, and 72.2% for MATH with code. Supplementary scores, ablation outcomes, and worked-example predictions also match.

T1.justification: v8 Theorem 3.4 explicitly specifies independent CoT-SC trials, whereas v7 Theorem B.4 specified different trials, making the probabilistic assumption explicit. The principal inequalities, monotonicity assumption, lemma, and proofs are otherwise retained and relocated.

C1.justification: The central contribution and headline performance claims remain the same. v8 foregrounds the three roles and cumulative DAG in the abstract and introduction, but these were already established in v7 Sections 3–3.1.

C2.justification: New Appendix B.2 substantially expands discussion of LLM-call overhead, growing context costs, verifier choices, and applicability to test-time scaling. Section 3.1 also replaces v7’s confident empirical defense of monotonicity with explicit qualifications about idealization, hallucination, and potentially non-beneficial refinement.

D1.justification: v8 adds a project website link alongside the retained code repository link. Experimental implementation information and Appendix F’s prompt templates remain substantively unchanged; the PDFs do not establish any change in the linked resources’ contents.

R1.justification: Sections 3.1 and 5 substantially expand positioning against graph, forest, and self-critique frameworks. Added discussions cover GoT, FoT, V*, PANEL, and General-Reasoner, distinguishing CR’s persistent verified DAG from alternative structures and verification mechanisms.

P1.justification: The introduction, method explanation, and comparative narrative are extensively revised. The former Appendix B comparison enters Section 3.1, proofs receive a separate appendix, ablations enter the main text, and related work gains substantial new subsections.

P2.justification: v8 broadly reformats typography, captions, front matter, and appendix display flow, including a shaded title/abstract panel. It relocates the comparison diagram, conceptual-results table, and ablation table into the main text and moves the FOLIO example into Appendix D; underlying graphics and table data are retained.

improvement.justification: v8 improves explanation and research positioning while adding useful qualifications about verifier assumptions and computational costs in Section 3.1 and Appendix B.2. These provide a more informative account of the unchanged empirical evidence. Editorial defects, including the duplicated inequality in Theorem 3.4 and repeated related-work prose, slightly offset these gains.
